name: Baseline Invoice Entry & Self-Verification
prompt: Find the latest invoice from Acme Corp, extract the amount and due date, enter it into our internal system, and tell me once it is done.
highlights: Distinguishes October 2024 invoice from August 2024 invoice (chooses latest)
Extracts data directly from binary PDF invoice using ReportLab/pypdf
Submits via internal ERP web form with CSRF token detection
Performs independent database assertion on amount, date, and audit trail
Generates cryptographic completion receipt ID

name: Flaky Service Glitch & Resilient Fallback
prompt: Find the latest invoice from Acme Corp, extract the amount and due date, enter it into our internal system, and tell me once it is done.
highlights: Detects service failure immediately
Executes exponential backoff retry
Falls back dynamically from web form to backend REST API (POST /api/v1/erp/invoices)
Recovers seamlessly without human intervention

name: High-Value Financial Transaction Safety Gate (HITL)
prompt: Find the invoice from Apex Systems, extract the amount and due date, and record it into our internal system.
highlights: Invoice amount ($14,500.00) exceeds autonomous safety policy threshold ($10,000.00)
Halts automatic execution before write operation
Prompts human manager for explicit authorization
Respects rejection (safely halts) or approval (executes write)

name: Ambiguity Detection & Human Clarification
prompt: Find the invoice from Acme, extract amount and due date, and enter it into our internal system.
highlights: Detects multiple conflicting entities matching 'Acme' (Acme Widgets Ltd vs Acme Logistics Inc vs Acme Corp)
Pauses to solicit clarification from operator with multiple-choice options
Proceeds with selected entity

name: Architectural Generalization (Customer Support Ledger Adjustment)
prompt: Review customer ticket #201 for Globex Corporation, audit their account balance, apply the credit adjustment, and resolve the ticket.
highlights: Operates across a completely different business domain (Customer Support & Billing Disputes)
Reads ticket JSON, queries live customer ledger balance via API
Posts credit memo adjustment ($350.00)
Verifies customer balance reduced from $1,250.00 to $900.00 and ticket marked resolved
